variants.note: Loose straw fans grouped along the cut field margin, with a few stalk ends pointing along the harvested rows.
Broad crumbs and clods beside a furrow, shaded at their seat and aligned to the cultivation direction.
Clusters of orchard leaves and a few dull windfall shapes under the canopy margin, without pickup glints or a scattered-item carpet.
